summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda(Transform) appended at the end (asserts callable(func) with message "func must be callable"; __call__ returns func(img)). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: typing import now includes Callable; Lambda added to the array import; Lambdad(MapTransform) inserted between ConcatItemsd and the alias block (constructor validates keys via MapTransform, builds one internal Lambda; __call__ shallow-copies with dict() and applies the Lambda to each key); LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended to the alias block. The IdentityD alias line was accidentally altered during editing and then restored; the diff shows only the typing import line removed. Added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py (identity, slicing, keys view, unlisted-entry preservation, iterable callable, aliases, assertion and empty-keys errors). Added Lambda and Lambdad entries to docs/source/transforms.rst. Tests, flake8 and black were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
